summary: Post-loading session/scene initialization orchestrator. Hides the cursor, conditionally loads an FIA short BIK video when championship mode (dword_7D0410 == 4), session type 7 and timer flag dword_7D032C == 1 all hold, then chains subsystem setup: guarded module-manager dispatch, global/session-type resets, camera viewport configuration, current-vehicle binding from the active-vehicle pointer array, game-state/audio dispatch, and — gated on ScoringGateCheck — scene file load, camera and collision handling, and telemetry dump. Returns the BIK file-load result.

operations.description: Hide the cursor: loop ShowCursor(0) until its return value goes negative. Invoked from sub_485B90's session-setup path.
Championship-intro gate: when dword_7D0410 == 4, dword_7C56A4 == 7 and dword_7D032C == 1, load the FIA short BIK video; otherwise skip the BIK load.
Compose the BIK path: use dword_5EC418 as the path base when non-null, else byte_5EA438, formatted as '%s%s' (aSS) with the aFiashortBik suffix via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck.
Load the composed BIK file with a retry loop (FileLoadWithRetryLoop) and store the file-load result into v0.
Dispatch a guarded subsystem call according to the current module-manager state (dword_7CD25C).
Reset global state and session-type flag: GlobalStateSetter(0) and sub_42D210(&dword_7C569C, 0).
Reset the global float (GlobalFloatSetter(0)) and batch-configure the camera viewport from the module pointer array ppvOut.
Run a short computation on the session manager object dword_5EA510.
Bind the current vehicle: dword_7C54DC = dword_7C54E4 (index) and dword_7C54E0 = dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54E4] (pointer from the active-vehicle array).
Dispatch the game-state branch and conditional audio on the session manager object dword_5EA510.
Zero-guarded division computation on flt_5EA4E8, followed by a guarded subsystem release.
Run remaining short computations: ShortComputation_50c0(), ShortComputation_bdf0(&dword_7CD204) and sub_4B9FD0(&dword_8AB6E4).
Scoring gate: proceed into scene/camera/collision setup only when ScoringGateCheck() returns non-zero.
Load a file while preserving the identity flag (FileLoadWithFlagPreserve(&dword_7C73E8)) and issue an initial scene render update (SceneRenderUpdate(0)).
Read the player vehicle pointer dword_7C54E8 and its sub-object pointer at +13024.
When the sub-object is non-null and the byte flag at vehicle +13388 is set, run UtilityFunction_4000 on the sub-object and then Camera(sub-object).
When session type dword_7C56A4 != 7, or race phase dword_7C56A8 is not 2/3/4, run VehicleClimbAdjust(0) and CollisionWrapperWithLock(vehicle + 12).
Return v0, the FIA BIK file-load result (0 when the BIK was not loaded).
